mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.login_name, u.user_name, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, pinfo.post_id, pinfo.post_name, u.phonenumber, u.status as user_status, s.entry_date, s.leave_date, s.rotation_anchor_date, s.default_shift_id, sh.shift_name as default_shift_name, ifnull(s.attendance_enabled, '1') as attendance_enabled, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id left join ( select up.user_id, max(up.post_id) as post_id, group_concat(p.post_name order by p.post_sort separator ',') as post_name from sys_user_post up left join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id group by up.user_id ) pinfo on pinfo.user_id = u.user_id left join hr_employee_setting s on s.user_id = u.user_id left join hr_shift sh on sh.shift_id = s.default_shift_id
mapper.select:
u.del_flag = '0' and u.login_name like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%') and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and u.dept_id = #{deptId} and exists (select 1 from sys_user_post up where up.user_id = u.user_id and up.post_id = #{postId}) and ifnull(s.attendance_enabled, '1') = #{attendanceEnabled} and s.entry_date >= #{params.beginEntryDate} and s.entry_date <= #{params.endEntryDate}
and s.user_id is not null and s.entry_date is not null and s.default_shift_id is not null
and (s.user_id is null or s.entry_date is null or s.default_shift_id is null)
and (s.leave_date is null or s.leave_date >= curdate())
and s.leave_date is not null and s.leave_date < curdate()
order by u.dept_id asc, u.login_name asc
select count(1) from hr_employee_setting where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into hr_employee_setting( user_id, entry_date, leave_date, default_shift_id, attendance_enabled, rotation_anchor_date, remark, create_by, create_time ) values( #{userId}, #{entryDate}, #{leaveDate}, #{defaultShiftId}, #{attendanceEnabled}, #{rotationAnchorDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
